title: Institutional Policy separates policy meaning, authority, publication and deployment lifecycle
summary: Institutional Policy provides the shared mechanics for immutable policy identity, authored/approved/published authority, effective-time selection, supersession, operative versus counterfactual replay, suspension/resume/withdrawal/ratification, delegation/revocation and bounded emergency authority.
invariants: Business-domain semantics remain in the owning domain; Institutional Policy owns deployment/governance mechanics.
Historical publication and authority evidence cannot be rewritten by later governance changes.
SUSPEND/RESUME/WITHDRAW are deployment evidence, not mutation of the policy artifact.
Emergency publication is explicit, bounded, and separately evidenced.

provenance.claim: Institutional Policy v0.8 documents shared authority, lifecycle, replay and emergency governance mechanics.
